Ford Transit Passenger 250 – Promotional Decals

Now that the flu season is here, you’ll see a lot of buzz about flu shots. To promote and encourage people to get their flu shot, you’ll see authorities pushing the advertisement via a number of mediums, such as the internet, streaming services, TV, radio, etc.

The methods we mentioned above can be a bit aggressive since they interrupt a viewer’s activity and it can be a bit annoying. However, there is a way you can advertise where you won’t be shoving your ad in their faces, instead, they’ll be at full liberty to see or not see it.

Vehicle Decals are the answer when you want to utilize all the real estate on your vehicle and make sure your advertisement gets seen by people who are actually interested in looking at it. Thus having a greater chance of turning those viewers into potential customers. The Decals on the vehicle also provide as a marker for people looking for a mobile clinic.

Our recent client was aware of the power of vehicle decals. We had the pleasure to work with one of Toronto’s best Marketing & Advertising agencies, Klick Health. They brought 2 Ford Transit Passenger 250s to Vinyl Wrap Toronto. These Ford Transit Passenger 250s were to be their Mobile Flu Shot Clinics.

The company wanted to kill two birds with one stone. Which are:

  1. Promote and encourage people to get flu shots.
  2. Encourage people to join their team of klicksters.

We heard them and gave them exactly what they wanted. We installed decals on almost all sides of the vehicles. We used Avery Dennison’s Gloss Intense Blue from their SW900 Series and Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl. Vinyl Wrap Toronto always uses the best quality material. The decals are easy to read and aren’t all up in your face. We’ve attached pictures on this page for you to see how we turned two ordinary Ford Transit Passenger 250s into moving billboards.

Vehicle Decals are a preferred choice for business promotion because of the following reasons:

  • Vehicle Decals are relatively cost-effective, considering their lifespan and low maintenance.
  • You are the boss; you get full freedom to pick any size, shape, finish, and colour of decals.
  • Vehicle decals are a proven way to effectively promote a business of service.
  • Decals are easy to install and remove (By professionals).
  • You take your advertising with you wherever you go.

If you’ve got a vehicle that could be promoting your business every day as you drive, we’re here to make that happen for you. For any queries or concerns, feel free to contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4, to speak to one of our experts.
